title: Twist Library Prep: Ligate Adapters
author: Opentrons
materials: should be run through the thermocycler program outlined in the [Twist Library Prep protocol](https://www.twistbioscience.com/sites/default/files/resources/2019-09/Protocol_NGS_EnzymaticFragUniversalAdapterSystem_11Sep19_Rev1.pdf) before being moved back to the OT-2 for this protocol. This protocol begins by adding 5µL of the Twist Universal Adapters to each well containing samples from [part one](https://develop.protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/21e4d8-pt1), followed by the addition of 45µL of Ligation Master Mix. The user is then prompted to remove plate and incubate the samples on a thermocycler. Following incubation, the user will return the plate to the OT-2 for a fully-automated magbead-based wash process (2 times) that will result in the 15µL of supernatant transferred to labware selected by the user. The user should then take the labware containing the supernatant and run on the thermocycler before moving to [part three](https://develop.protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/21e4d8-pt3). If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at [protocols@opentrons.com](mailto:protocols@opentrons.com). --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentro

steps.title: Run initial thermocycler program
steps.instruction: Place the final plate from Part 1 on a thermocycler and run the program outlined in the Twist Library Prep protocol, then move the plate back to the OT‑2 deck.

steps.title: Add adapters and ligation mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 µL of Twist Universal Adapters into each well containing the sample, followed by 45 µL of Ligation Master Mix.

steps.title: Incubate on thermocycler
steps.instruction: Prompt the user to remove the plate from the OT‑2 and incubate the samples on a thermocycler using the appropriate program.

steps.title: Perform magnetic bead washes
steps.instruction: Return the incubated plate to the OT‑2 and run the fully‑automated magnetic‑bead‑based wash process twice; transfer the resulting 15 µL of supernatant to labware selected by the user.

steps.title: Final thermocycler run
steps.instruction: Take the labware containing the 15 µL supernatant and run it on the thermocycler before proceeding to Part 3 of the Twist Library Prep workflow.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If needed, upload any custom labware definition files to the OT‑2 system.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck layout exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration routine.

steps.title: Start the automated run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the protocol.
